profile.description: Get instant answers thought AI-powered search. Combining speed, reasoning and accuracy. Find what you need, quickly and easily. Web-Search-AI is based on an AI-powered search engine with internet scraping capabilities. To enable source mode use the `--source` flag. To activate deep thinking mode, use the flag `--deep`. Add `--tool` for Poe bot search. Tools and data analysis will cost additional points.
